pack price down, unit price up
pack price down at least in proportion: reported, not shrinkflation (D35)
different store, no earlier price there: pack got smaller
a smaller promo pack in between is ignored
promo skipped: the event compares the two regular prices
a smaller pack seen only on promo is no event
Q_new = Q_prev x 0.99 counts (<=)
Q_new = Q_prev x 0.991: no event
previous price is Aldi; classified against Rewe's earlier price
two shrinks in a row: two events
4 x 100 g -> 3 x 100 g at the same price
1 lb -> 400 g, US book per oz
pack got bigger: no event
prices without a store have no same-store reference
same shelf price, coupon paid price: kind uses the shelf price, unit uses paid
D42 / review #6: 1 kg 8.99 -> 500 g 4.99 -> 1 kg -> 500 g at one store: only the first switch is reported, and as a different pack size (50 % smaller), never shrinkflation
D42: 6 x 330 ml and 4 x 330 ml bought alternately: no repeated events
D42: switching back to a known size is no event; a NEW smaller size of the same pack still is
D42: exactly 30 % smaller is still classified (samePrice); 30.1 % is a different pack size
2 regular + 2 promo in the window: median of all 4
3 regular prices: promo excluded from the median
empty 365-day window: median of the last 5 prices (older data)
today - 365 days counts, today - 366 does not
odd count: the middle value
even count, middle two 1.00/300 g and 1.01/300 g: exact mean (no rounding)
fewer than 3 prices: building your history
exactly 3 prices: verdicts shown
highest far above usual: the 'above usual' band exists
% vs usual half up away from zero: +2.5 -> +3, -2.5 -> -3
every price free: usual 0, % not defined
latest exactly 90 days ago is fresh, 91 days is stale
no store seen in 90 days: no 'last seen cheapest'
two stores with the same latest unit price share the badge
prices without a store get a row but never the badge
a store whose latest price is a promo: the promo counts for that store
same date: created_at decides the latest
equal lowest prices: the most recent one is shown
a price in a volume unit on a mass product is not used
paid price after a deal drives the unit price; deposit never does
JPY book: 0 decimals when every value >= 1 yen
count product per roll: 3 decimals under 1 euro
US book per fl oz, liters and fl oz mixed
no prices at all
one price: tiles, no gauge
